sections.markdown:
## B — Graduated licensing and license records
Audience: first-time Montana non-commercial Class D applicants studying graduated licensing and license records.
Level: introductory rule retrieval; the ordered handbook section is the coverage basis, without any invented official examination weight. Prerequisites and confusable topics: The prior section’s ordinary learner-permit and identity-document requirements.
This is a research handoff. Page seventeen contributes GDL content only. Fee tables and license-duration schedules conflict with other chapter text and are withheld as debt. Appointment instructions conflict between pages eleven and twenty; no blanket scheduling rule is asserted.
